exp.en: Nam Kyung-joo's side admitted to attempting sexual relations, but denied exercising power or actual rape, claiming innocence.

exp.en: According to the data, Jensen Huang returned as CEO after resigning.

exp.en: According to the data, Kang Si-hoo participated as the 7th hitter in the preliminaries at the tournament held at Gunsan Country Club and placed 2nd.

q.en: Supreme Council Member Choi Min-hee stated that she immediately accepted the disciplinary decision right after the ethics tribunal's resolution.

exp.en: According to the data, Choi expressed her intention to apply for a retrial, stating it was 'difficult to accept' via SNS.

q.ko: 남경주 씨 사건의 법적 공방 중 하나는 뮤지컬계에서의 사회적 지위나 보호·감독 관계를 이용해 위력을 행사했는가 하는 점이다.
q.en: One of the legal battles in Nam Kyung-joo's case is whether he exercised power by using his social status or protective and supervisory relationship in the musical world.

exp.en: The data shows that the prosecution and defense disputed whether Nam exercised power using his social status or supervisory relationship in the musical industry.
